meta.title: See What Your Accident Case Is Worth — Free Review

hero.sub: Most accident victims walk away with a fraction of what they're owed. Answer 8 quick questions — find out what your case is actually worth, 100% free.

s1.label: Question 1 of 8
s1.question: What type of accident were you in?
s1.hint: Even minor injuries could be owed significant money.

s3.label: Question 3 of 8
s3.question: Who was primarily at fault for the accident?

s4.label: Question 4 of 8
s4.question: Were you injured in the accident?

s5.label: Question 5 of 8
s5.question: Did you receive medical treatment after the accident?
s5.hint: Medical records are key to maximizing your compensation.
options: Not Yet — My Accident Was Recent
No — It's Been Over 30 Days and I Haven't Seen a Doctor

s6.label: Question 6 of 8
s6.question: Are you currently represented by an attorney?
options: No, I Don't Have an Attorney

s7.label: Question 7 of 8
s7.question: Almost Finished!
s7.hint: Tell us what happened in your accident so we can estimate your potential payout.
s7.hintExample: (i.e. "Hit by a speeding driver at an intersection, injured my shoulder")
s7.placeholder: e.g. "Hit by a speeding driver at an intersection, injured my shoulder and neck..."
s7.errorMsg: ⚠ This field is required. Please describe your accident to continue.

s8.label: Almost Done!
s8.question: Where should we send your free case review?
s8.qualifyBox: Based on your answers, you may qualify for significant compensation. A licensed attorney will reach out within minutes — no obligation, no upfront cost.
s8.submitBtn: Get My FREE Case Review Now
s8.submitSub: No Fees Unless We Win · 100% Confidential · Takes 30 Seconds

thankyou.title: You're All Set!
thankyou.sub: A licensed attorney in your area will reach out within the next few minutes to review your case — at zero cost to you.
thankyou.nextBody: Keep your phone nearby. A local attorney will call to go over your options. You are under no obligation to hire anyone.

hiw.step1Desc: Takes under 60 seconds. No paperwork needed.
hiw.step2Desc: A local attorney contacts you within minutes.
hiw.step3Desc: You pay nothing unless your case is won.
